convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iMA for EMA crossover). Simple entry/exit rules with fixed SL/TP. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic. Standard market orders. Straightforward position sizing.

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative Lots value = fixed lot size; positive Lots value = fraction of free margin to use for position sizing

custom_logic_notes: EA uses 8/21 EMA crossover system (classic chaos/scalp pattern). Signal is evaluated on previous completed bar values (shift 1 vs shift 2) to avoid repainting. Digit adjustment applied: SL and TP values are multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 to normalize pip values across 4-digit and 5-digit brokers. Position gate ensures only one position at a time - opposite signal closes existing trade and reverses.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward EMA crossover strategy. Use pandas EWM for EMA calculation. Ensure digit adjustment logic is replicated for multi-decimal symbols. The conditional lots logic (negative=fixed, positive=margin fraction) must be handled explicitly. Entry signals use previous bar comparison (shift 1 vs 2), not current bar - implement as completed-bar-only evaluation. Single position constraint with reversal on opposite signal is the core flow.
